description.value:
Duration constant

A creature that has been under HEAT DEBT since the end of your last turn is slowed 1 and reduces any resistance it has by 5. If it has been under HEAT DEBT for three consecutive rounds, it is slowed 2 instead and reduces its resistances by 10. These effects end when the chill does.

cinderfall.incomplete: Requires tracking 'since the end of your last turn' and 'three consecutive rounds' of a custom HEAT DEBT condition -- no rule element auto-increments a custom counter round over round outside a named condition's own badge-increment or a SpecialResource, neither of which exists for this shape (NOSTACK); HEAT DEBT itself also has no schema representation anywhere in the corpus.
